_question: Published series printing BOTH a survival figure AND the patient-level data behind it, so a curve-digitization method could be validated against real ground truth.
_definition_of_hit: figure-truth pair in ONE accessible source: a survival figure PLUS per-patient time+event data for the same patients (per-subject table, swimmer plot, or supplementary IPD).
_prohibitions_observed: No reconstruction, no digitization, no inversion, no pooling, no patient-level dataset produced. No clinical claim. Cataloguing only.
_retrieval_route: PubMed MCP tools only (search_articles, get_article_metadata, convert_article_ids, get_full_text_article). No other network.
_route_limitation_that_governs_every_ver: mcp__PubMed__get_full_text_article returns narrative text ONLY. It strips table contents, figure images and figure/table numbers (inline citations collapse to '()' or 'Table.'). The two halves of a figure-truth pair live exactly in the stripped material. Therefore NO verdict below is confirmed by direct inspection of a table or a figure through this route; verdicts rest on (a) the repository's own committed artifacts for the two known fragments, and (b) narrative text that names a per-patient table or a KM figure.

candidates.title: Results of sub-analysis of a phase 2 study on trabectedin treatment for extraskeletal myxoid chondrosarcoma and mesenchymal chondrosarcoma
candidates.disease: EMCS (2) + MCS (3) in trabectedin arm; MCS (3) in BSC arm
candidates.access_state: OPEN ACCESS in PMC. Narrative full text RETRIEVED under this worker via PubMed MCP (2026-09-08). Tables and figures NOT delivered by that route.

figure.what: Fig. 1 Kaplan-Meier plot of progression-free survival, two arms (trabectedin, best supportive care)
figure.risk_row_source: research/modalities/emc-ipd-survival.json -> candidate_sources[].figure_finding.risk_table_printed (trabectedin 0..21 mo, BSC at 0); committed repository artifact, NOT re-measured by S6

ground_truth.form: per-subject efficacy table (Table 2, 'Summary of efficacy'), trabectedin group
ground_truth.n_covered_claimed_by_repo_record: per-subject efficacy for the trabectedin group; the repository transcribed 2 EMCS rows (PFS 13.0/7.4 mo, OS 26.4/10.4 mo, both uncensored) verified against the PDF text layer of page 4
ground_truth.coverage_of_BSC_arm: UNKNOWN - not established by any evidence S6 retrieved
ground_truth.supporting_narrative_retrieved_by_S6: The article's Results address subjects individually by number ('subject No. 1', 'No. 2', 'No. 3') and state 'Clinical information of these subjects is presented in Table'; one MCS subject was still on treatment at cutoff and two of five were alive, so per-patient censoring status is stated in prose as well.

candidates.both_halves_reachable_at_0: YES for a human with a browser (PMC open access, CC BY). NOT through the PubMed MCP route alone, which delivers neither the table nor the figure.
caveats: The truth half is confirmed at n=2 (the two EMCS subjects) by the repository's committed transcription; full coverage of the 5-subject trabectedin arm is asserted by the repository record, and coverage of the 3-subject BSC arm is UNKNOWN.
n is tiny (8 across both arms). A validation of a digitizer against this pair would be a single-figure, small-n check, not a bound.
The curve is over a mixed-histology arm; it is NOT an EMC cohort curve. No clinical reading of any kind follows.
NOT the denied 'Trabectedin/RT 2018' item (DOI 10.4172/clinical-practice.1000433); different paper, not on the CLOSED-WORK denied list.
candidates.grading_rationale: The Fig. 1 KM curve spans BOTH arms (trabectedin n=5, BSC n=3) on PFS. The per-subject truth is CONFIRMED only for 2 subjects (the two EMCS rows the repository transcribed); coverage of the remaining 3 trabectedin subjects is asserted by the repository record but not established by anything S6 retrieved, and coverage of the 3 BSC subjects is UNKNOWN. Per the weaker-reading rule this is patient-level data covering PART of a mixed cohort, i.e. ADJACENT. It would become MATCHED only if Table 2 were shown to print time and event status for every patient in the arm whose curve is being read - which S6 had no admitted route to check.

candidates.access_state: OPEN ACCESS in PMC (Rare Tumors). Narrative full text RETRIEVED under this worker 2026-09-08. Tables and figures NOT delivered by that route.

figure.numbers_at_risk_row_printed: UNKNOWN - not measurable through this route

A KM analysis is stated in Methods and a per-patient treatment table is referred to in Results ('can be seen for each patient in'), but whether a survival FIGURE is printed, and whether the per-patient table carries follow-up time and vital status for the same 15 patients, are both unresolved. Recorded as UNKNOWN, not as a probable pair.

structural_finding.size_rule: OBSERVED, NOT PROVEN: within the small screened set, per-patient rows appear only in very small reports (trial sub-analyses of 5-8 subjects; single-institution case series around 15), while series of 40+ print aggregate tables and are exactly the series large enough for a digitization method to matter. The figure-truth pair and the figure worth digitizing pull in opposite directions.
structural_finding.search_instrument_limit: PubMed indexes titles, abstracts and MeSH. It does NOT index table contents or figure captions. 'swimmer plot' AND sarcoma returns 0 records although the campaign holds a retained sarcoma swimmer plot. The class being enumerated is therefore, in principle, not searchable through this admitted route; it is only screenable article by article.

_coordinator_narrowing_applied.received_utc: 2026-09-08 during S6 run, after candidates.json v1 was written; v2 (this file) supersedes it
_coordinator_narrowing_applied.1_withdrawn: A matched figure/truth pair tests a method ON THAT PAIR ONLY. The claim that one pair 'would convert the synthetic line into a validated or refuted claim about real figures' is WITHDRAWN. One pair is one figure, one cohort, one endpoint, one journal's rendering. Transfer beyond the pairs actually tested is UNKNOWN.
_coordinator_narrowing_applied.2_withdrawn: An empty or thin result here is a BOUNDED SOURCE/REACHABILITY RESULT about what S6 searched and what was reachable at $0. It is not publishable-grade by default, not paper merit, not a manuscript admission. The reverse holds equally: FINDING pairs admits no paper. Source availability is not paper admission.
_coordinator_narrowing_applied.3_grading_rule: MATCHED = per-patient data covers the SAME cohort and SAME endpoint as the survival figure. ADJACENT = per-subject data for a different subset, a different endpoint, a differently-defined population, or only some arms of a mixed cohort; an adjacent fragment DOES NOT supply ground truth for that figure. Where a source does not settle it, the weaker reading (ADJACENT or UNKNOWN) is recorded.
_coordinator_narrowing_applied.4_closures: Unaffected. No closed or held source was pursued. PMID 32856598 (Wagner) surfaced in one search result list and was dropped without retrieval.

overall_result.statement: Within the scope S6 actually searched, ZERO figure-truth pairs were ESTABLISHED as MATCHED. One candidate (fice2022emc) is UNKNOWN and would need one look at a table and a figure to settle. Both fragments named in the dispatch were tested against the MATCHED definition and neither passes: one is ADJACENT (partial-cohort truth against a mixed-arm curve), the other prints no survival curve at all.
overall_result.what_this_is_not: This is a bounded statement about what these queries reached through one retrieval route on 2026-09-08. It is NOT evidence that the class is empty in the literature, NOT a paper, NOT paper merit, and NOT an admission of anything into any manuscript. It licenses no clinical statement of any kind.
